# EqualizerSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")`

Raises or lowers three frequency bands: low, middle and high. Cutting the lows and the highs sounds like a radio; keeping only the lows sounds like a voice through a wall.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HighGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The gain of the high band, in decibels, from -80 to 12. |
| `LowGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The gain of the low band, in decibels, from -80 to 12. |
| `MidGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The gain of the middle band, in decibels, from -80 to 12. |
| `MidHigh` | `number` | `4000` | read/write | The frequency where the middle band ends, in hertz. The high band is above it. |
| `MidLow` | `number` | `400` | read/write | The frequency where the middle band begins, in hertz. The low band is below it. |
